messages:
Maya: Hey team — incoming debug bundle for ticket SUP-4821. Customer said they hit a 502 and attached a bundle that contains the full prompt + convo. Request ID shown in logs: req_20260317_9a1b. They consented to "share with eng & legal" but not infra yet. @Sam can you advise what minimal repro we need and a redaction checklist?

Sam: Do we have a curl or SDK call? If curl, ask them to paste a sanitized one. If SDK, ask for the exact request headers (x-request-id) + model params. Minimal repro should hit the same error with as few tokens as possible.

Maya: They uploaded a debug bundle link (removed). I pulled the request_ids file — contains req_20260317_9a1b and req_20260317_9a1c. The prompt includes emails and full customer names. @Priya — can you confirm what we must redact before sharing more widely?

Priya: Redaction checklist (short):
- Replace personal names, emails, phone numbers, SSNs with placeholders like <NAME_1>, <EMAIL_1>, <PHONE_1>.
- Mask account IDs, org IDs, API keys, tokens: <ID_1>, <API_KEY_1>.
- Replace IP addresses and exact geolocation with <IP> / <LOCATION>.
- If prompt contains highly sensitive health/financial content, redact whole message.
- Never include raw Authorization headers or API keys in uploaded bundles; replace with <REDACTED_TOKEN>.
Also: keep a private mapping in your ticket (not in the shared bundle) for correlating placeholders.

Sam: For reproducibility, ask the customer for a one-line sanitized curl like this (they should replace sensitive bits with placeholders):
```bash
curl "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>' \n  -H 'x-request-id: req_20260317_9a1b' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-4b","input":"<REDACTED_PROMPT_SNIPPET>","max_tokens":32}'
```
(They can reduce max_tokens to 32 to speed repro.)

Maya: Got it. Quick legal question — @Ava — customer said "share with eng & legal". Do we need explicit text to include infra partners? We might need to pull infra in for runtime troubleshooting.

Ava: If the customer text explicitly lists "Redwood engineering and infrastructure partners" that's sufficient. If not, ask for one-line written consent in the ticket or email. If they refuse, we can still debug with a more aggressively redacted bundle kept within Redwood. Also note retention: sanitized bundles retained 90 days by default.

Maya: I just messaged the customer asking: please confirm if we can also share with "Redwood infra and partner ops" and asked them to remove client emails. Customer replied: "OK to share with Redwood eng & infra partners for debugging. Please remove client emails." They also attached a sanitized curl but left an org ID. We'll redact that too.

Sam: I created a quick repro in staging and hit the same 502. Observed header x-internal-route: batch-worker-7 and an OOM-ish stack trace. For deeper debug we need: kernel logs around 2026-03-17 14:12, agent.log lines for req_20260317_9a1b, and the full response error body (with user content redacted).

Priya: When collecting logs please run these sanitization commands before uploading:
- Emails: sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/<EMAIL>/g' logfile > logfile.sanitized
- IPs: sed -E 's/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/<IP>/g' logfile > logfile.sanitized_ip
- API keys/tokens: sed -E 's/(api_key|authorization|token)[:=] ?[A-Za-z0-9_\-\.=]+/<REDACTED_TOKEN>/Ig' logfile > logfile.sanitized_tokens
Also remove any lines that contain whole social-security-like patterns; if unsure, redact the entire line.

Sam: One more: include the x-request-id header + short response body so we can replay exact failure. If possible switch model to small (rwd-4b) and max_tokens 32 for replay.

debug-bundle-bot: Debug bundle uploaded: "SUP-4821/sanitized_bundle_v1.zip" (access: restricted).

Maya: I'll assemble the sanitized bundle, keep a private mapping file in the ticket, and ask customer to sign the consent line for infra sharing. Once Ava gives final OK I'll share with infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Ava: Sounds good. Please attach the written consent to the ticket and mark bundle as "sanitized_for_infra".

Sam: Ping me once the sanitized bundle is attached; I'll run a reproduce job and post logs here.

Maya: Will do — closing loop for now.
